summary: The agent provides a solid, structurally sound solution with appropriate feature engineering, data cleaning, and cross-validation setup. However, it relies on a naive equal-weight ensemble without tuning the weights using its computed out-of-fold predictions. Furthermore, it completely fails to compute or print any evaluation metrics, leaving the user blind to the actual performance of the model.
